Developing bdhs

Source: DEVELOPMENT.md

Notes for anyone (people or coding agents) changing this package.

Rules that are never broken

  1. No DHS microdata in the repository or the package. DHS terms of use forbid redistributing respondent-level data “directly or within any tool”. Never commit, bundle, snapshot, print or save row-level values. .gitignore, .Rbuildignore and tools/check-tarball.sh (run in CI) block data file types; do not weaken them. Metadata (names, labels, value labels, counts) and aggregate estimates are fine.
  2. Examples, tests and vignettes run without real data, using bdhs_simulate() and temporary directories (withr::local_tempdir()). They never use the network and never write outside tempdir().
  3. Tests on the maintainer’s real files are skipped unless BDHS_LOCAL_TESTS=true; files are found under BDHS_LOCAL_DIR (default ~/Documents/MU/Research). Use skip_if_no_local_data() and local_data_dir() from tests/testthat/helper-local.R. Such tests assert on aggregates only.
  4. Never handle credentials. bdhs_download() reads the DHS password from keyring, DHS_PASSWORD or an askpass prompt.

Layout

Area Files Exported functions
Rounds, recodes surveys.R, recodes.R bdhs_survey_id(), bdhs_rounds(), bdhs_recodes()
Synthetic data simulate.R bdhs_simulate()
Bundled data data.R, data-raw/ bdhs_indicators, bdhs_indicator_catalog, bdhs_surveys, bdhs_datasets, bdhs_codebook, bdhs_value_labels, bdhs_regions, bdhs_pool_population

Your files store.R, identify.R, import.R, read.R, download.R, sitrep.R bdhs_data_dir(), bdhs_import(), bdhs_identify_file(), bdhs_inventory(), bdhs_read(), bdhs_read_file(), bdhs_download(), bdhs_forget(), bdhs_sitrep()
Harmonization crosswalk.R, harmonize.R, pool.R, merge.R, missing.R bdhs_harmonize(), bdhs_harmonized_vars(), bdhs_pool(), bdhs_merge(), bdhs_na()
Design and estimation design.R, indicators.R, indicator-defs-*.R, estimate.R, rates.R, validate.R bdhs_design(), bdhs_design_info(), bdhs_indicator_list(), bdhs_add_indicators(), bdhs_estimate(), bdhs_fertility(), bdhs_mortality(), bdhs_validate(), bdhs_validation_record()

Key contracts:

  • bdhs_read() returns a tibble with lower-case names, haven labels kept and attributes bdhs_survey_id, bdhs_recode, bdhs_file. data_survey_id(data) / data_recode(data) detect them otherwise. Pooled data carry a survey_id column (is_pooled()).
  • bdhs_design(data, weight, strata, survey, recode, srvyr) returns a survey.design2: PSU v021/hv021/mv021, strata v022 (DHS sampling-error strata, every round), weight *005 / 1e6, nest = TRUE; pooled data use round-prefixed PSUs/strata and pool_wt. Evaluate variances with options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust") set locally.
  • bdhs_estimate() returns a tibble of class bdhs_estimate: survey_id, indicator, label, by-columns, estimate, se, ci_low, ci_high, n_unweighted, n_weighted, api_id; attributes level, scale, by_labels. Proportions are on the 0-100 scale.
  • Indicators are new_indicator() objects in R/indicator-defs-*.R (universe, value, all_women, window, rounds, api_id, params).
  • bdhs_official() returns tidy official values (bdhs_indicators), with preferred = FALSE exposing alternative reference periods (by_variable_label).
  • Internal helpers in R/utils.R: zap_all(), as_codes(), var_label(), lower_names(), first_present(), check_installed(), cli_escape(); dv(d, var) (numeric codes of a column, R/indicators.R).

Domain facts

  • Every BDHS women’s sample is ever-married women. All-women indicators use the all-woman factors (awfactt; awfactu/awfactr/awfacte/awfactw for subgroups; child-marriage tables use awfactt for every subgroup).
  • Divisions: 5 (1993-94), 6 (to 2007, + Sylhet), 7 (2011-2014, + Rangpur), 8 (2017-18 on, + Mymensingh as code 5, renumbering later divisions).
  • The 2022 women’s survey used a short questionnaire (sqtype == 2) for a third of women, without family planning, marriage and empowerment modules.
  • KR covers births in the last 5 years (3 years in 1993-94). BR has the full birth history. PR holds anthropometry for children and women.

Workflow

devtools::load_all(); devtools::document(); devtools::test()
Sys.setenv(BDHS_LOCAL_TESTS = "true"); devtools::test()   # with real files
  • New exported functions must be added to _pkgdown.yml (the test test-pkgdown.R and the website build fail otherwise).
  • Rscript tools/check-duplicate-defs.R catches top-level names defined twice (a later file silently overrides an earlier one).
  • data-raw/00-rebuild-from-local.R rebuilds codebooks and the validation record from the maintainer’s files (zips allowed).
  • Style: tidyverse style, cli for messages, rlang::arg_match(), pkg::fun for non-base calls, roxygen2 markdown with runnable offline examples, testthat 3e. Suggests packages via check_installed().
  • Commit messages end with a Co-Authored-By trailer when written with an AI assistant.
